spine.active_goal: A fresh session, held by a different person, resumes this thread and knows where the previous one stopped without reading git history. Three of seven goals are met and on main. The four open ones are the artifact merge (U3), the writers (U4), the briefing render (U5) and the two skills (U6).
spine.next_step: U6, the last unit, is in flight on branch docs/handoff-skills from main at 2dfcc477. It rewrites skills/debrief/SKILL.md into the four-step gather-and-park sequence, adds the record-as-you-go step to skills/preflight/SKILL.md, and adds two contract tests plus the stop-gate session-entry test from Task 6 step 4b. c7 closes on node --test test/contract/skills.test.ts exiting 0. Nothing follows it; when it merges the thread is ready to close.

open_risks.text: U5 moves the clip-budget fixture in test/contract/resume-settled-lane-clip-budget.test.ts. U1 shrank the render and had to raise that fixture; U5 adds a Landed block and a continuation sentence, moving it the other way.

Two intermittent tests exist and are unrelated to this work: concurrent.distinct-ids in test/spawn/decisions.test.ts, and error.discloses-no-path in test/contract/no-path.test.ts. Both pass in isolation and fail under parallel load. Re-run rather than investigate.

core.hooksPath points at a directory that does not exist, so no pre-commit hook has run on any commit in this repository and none will until that path exists. Git skips a missing hooks directory silently.

criterionContent in src/merge/field-merge.ts projects a criterion to four fields and never compares check, result or result_status, which were added in 7701a55d without updating the projection. When those diverge the merge finds the projections equal and silently discards the other side's recorded result. Same bug class as the artifacts drop; the new top-level census cannot catch it because it works at field granularity.

Escaping of spine.landed, Artifact.label and Artifact.pointer in resolve_conflict is implemented but unprobed: deleting those escape entries from the handling table turns no test red, because both new tests use values for which escapeStored is the identity.

The resolve_conflict census is closed over two FieldRule values rather than over the rule space, so a fifth variant added to the union falls into neither census and a path given that rule could be marked no-conflict with every test still passing.

resolve_conflict.ts is now 761 lines against the project's 800-line hard ceiling, roughly double the 200-400 typical band; the derived handling table at lines 327-473 is the clean extraction target when it next needs to grow.
park_thread checks session ownership only on the route where thread_id is omitted, so a second session supplying thread_id can overwrite spine.landed and release the first session's pointer.

Artifact label and pointer are stored unescaped by mintArtifacts while every other content field is escaped at write, so the injection defence rests entirely on every present and future render surface remembering to escape, and no forgery probe covers artifacts.
A retired risk or artifact still renders on logbook://thread/{id} because renderDetailThread does not filter on the tombstone, so that surface disagrees with the briefing, which does filter.

Retiring an artifact or a risk marks it instead of deleting it and nothing caps how many a thread accumulates, so enough retirements push a thread record to its byte cap and refuse every further write. The cap refusal tells the caller to remove an entry from the heaviest field, which for artifacts and open risks is now impossible.

The four new tool arguments were classified as ARGUMENT_GAPS rather than written into the tool descriptions, so park_thread's published description still says it refreshes the next_step field and an agent choosing arguments from that prose will not learn landed exists.

ArtifactAddSchema.pointer does not apply POINTER_PATTERN, so a pointer carrying a newline is refused naming the whole thread record instead of the field that was wrong. The two new spawn test files also cast arguments through RecordU+003Cstring, unknown>, discarding the compile-time proof that the new keys are on the published input type.

key_decisions.title: U3's census observes a real merge instead of comparing two hand-written lists
resolve_conflict derives one handling table keyed over every THREAD_RULES path
ScalarField derives by excluding arrays, not by testing for string
The retired-entry divergence on the thread resource is left open, not folded into U4
Preflight's record-as-you-go step goes before the briefing print, not after it

out_of_scope.text: Migrating data written by an earlier version of Logbook. Ruled out by H6; records predating the schema change are not carried forward.
Making the array merge base-aware. Tombstones work around it one collection at a time; the general fix touches every collection and the whole sync path.
Automatic capture of session content by a hook. A hook holds ids and a timestamp, never what the session did, so no hook can write the record that is missing.
